retrieval_query.mechanism_summary: Validation of external links before processing

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor
top_sast_rules.description: External links that open in a new tab or window but do not specify link type 'noopener' or 'noreferrer' are a potential security risk.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Find code that may expose sensitive information in error messages, logs, or responses
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement proper access controls and avoid exposing sensitive information in responses, errors, or logs.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Link Resolution Before File Access ('Link Following')
top_sast_rules.description: File access follows a symlink, hardlink, or shortcut to an unintended resource.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-59 symlink hardlink link-following symbolic-link file-link archive-extraction path-resolution file-overwrite race filesystem
top_sast_rules.remediation: Reject unsafe links and verify resolved file targets before access.

top_sast_rules.description: Separately checking the state of a file before operating on it may allow an attacker to modify the file between the two operations.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement secure coding practices specific to this vulnerability type. Review the query logic for detailed requirements.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of CRLF Sequences ('CRLF Injection')
top_sast_rules.description: Untrusted CR or LF characters are not neutralized before use in line-delimited protocol metadata.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-93 crlf-injection carriage-return line-feed newline header response-splitting http-header redirect cookie
top_sast_rules.remediation: Reject CR/LF in protocol metadata and use validating framework APIs.

top_sast_rules.description: If a conditional expression always evaluates to true or always evaluates to false, this suggests incomplete code or a logic error.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement secure coding practices specific to CWE-571. Review OWASP guidelines and CWE documentation for detailed mitigation strategies.

top_sast_rules.description: A restricted route, URL, script, or file can be requested directly without required authorization.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-425 forced-browsing direct-request restricted-url protected-route protected-file missing-authorization route endpoint hidden-link
top_sast_rules.remediation: Authorize every protected route and resource on direct access.

top_sast_rules.description: Legacy category for incorrect handling or transformation of structured data.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-19 data-processing parser parsing malformed-data format-conversion serialization transformation structured-data processing-error
top_sast_rules.remediation: Validate structured input and use safe parsing and conversion routines.

top_sast_rules.description: If a dollar assertion '$' appears in a regular expression before another term that cannot match the empty string, then this assertion can never match, so the entire regular expression cannot match any string.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Remove dead code through static analysis. Use code coverage tools to identify unreachable code. Implement regular code reviews to eliminate unused functionality.

top_sast_rules.description: Avoid using unstructured control flow statements (return, continue, or break) inside a 'finally' block.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement secure coding practices specific to CWE-584. Review OWASP guidelines and CWE documentation for detailed mitigation strategies.

top_sast_rules.description: An assignment to a local variable in a return statement is useless, since the variable will immediately go out of scope and its value is lost.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Remove unused variables that may contain sensitive data. Use static analysis tools to identify unused code. Review code for potential logic errors.
